comparison.objective: Remove spacer dowels so laminate bonds flat and registered on a drawer front.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential dowel extraction while controlling a thin adhesive sheet.
comparison.success_condition: Laminate bonds flat with required registration and overhang on all edges.
comparison.reason: Controlling irreversible sheet bonding is materially different from retaining and fastening a rigid articulated rack rail. The shared need to preserve alignment is generic.
